genius.notes: Fluid Finance SA, en liquidation is preserved as the historical legal issuer. The Swiss Official Gazette records bankruptcy dissolution effective April 22, 2024. The issuer FAQ dated December 31, 2021 remains retrievable through a same-page text mirror and describes USD minting, transfers and 1:1 DUSD redemption. redemptionPolicyPresent records that historical published policy, without asserting current redemption availability. No current reserve disclosure or monthly independent attestation was verified. The coin remains frozen, and daspOfferSaleStatus stays unknown because current operations and U.S. distribution were not established. No token-specific public GENIUS authorization or foreign registration was located. The September 30 SCRC procedural rule does not establish issuer qualification.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application or registered foreign exception was located for Fluid Finance SA or this historical DUSD as of 2026-10-07. The historical issuer FAQ documents USD payment/redemption mechanics and EU/UK availability, but no U.S. GENIUS filing. The Swiss Official Gazette records bankruptcy and the legal name Fluid Finance SA, en liquidation. Current reserve reporting and operational redemption were not verified.

applicabilityBasis.summary: Fluid DigitalDollar was historically described as a transferable USD-referenced token minted from treasury-account USD, burned on return and redeemable to a bank account at 1:1. The issuer-authored FAQ supports apparent payment-stablecoin treatment; frozen status and unverified current operations are separate facts.
